description: Before delegating any task, the orchestrator MUST call this tool and read its output before choosing a provider, model, effort, or profile. Do not route from a remembered model list or a separate delegation skill. Returns a compact plain-text guide from current configuration and committed quota observations: providers in capacity order, exact models, quota standing/freshness, admissible profiles, supported parameters, restrictions, and configured recommendations. The orchestrator makes the task-specific choice; the broker selects the account unless explicitly pinned. Follow the start/resume tool contracts for launch, binding, continuation and verified results. Read-only; schema_version 1 is Unsupported. Configured recommendations are guidance, not an automatic model-ability ranking.
